tasks.title: Reject admin tokens shorter than 32 characters and keep CI starting
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior R5, all Checks and Completion evidence. Raise the minimum and both messages, update affected fixtures and the docker CI sentinel to console-ci-sentinel-token-0123456789ab, and document the 32-character rule in both README.md settings rows (PULSE_CONSOLE_ADMIN_TOKEN and PULSE_CONSOLE_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE) and docs/configuration.md. Preserve trimming, optional sources, error secrecy and the existing order of validation rules; update expectations when a shorter invalid fixture now hits the length rule first. The docs change together as required by console AGENTS.md and revised R5. Capture the 31-character regression failing on console main c93f61cee3568e23e35233927f1aa1e3e015312a and passing on the branch.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail on the branch (focused coverage may exit nonzero). Both env and file refuse 31 characters with PULSE_CONSOLE_ADMIN_TOKEN must hold at least 32 characters or PULSE_CONSOLE_ADMIN_TOKEN_FILE=<path>: must hold at least 32 characters, without the secret. Both accept 32 characters after surrounding whitespace is trimmed; exactly-16-chars is refused. Existing source/error/rule ordering stays; length-compatible fixtures still exercise whitespace, ASCII and placeholder checks. Baseline accepts 31 characters, failing the new regression.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage. Settings fixtures and docs use 32, and src/main.startup.test.ts's existing 33-character fixture stays valid.
The service starts with the new sentinel; GET /readyz answers 200 and no token value appears in logs or the page. Record the command and result per console AGENTS.md.

CI including both docker jobs is green with the new sentinel, /readyz 200 and the existing no-token-in-logs/page assertions. PR body contains bun run check output, red-then-green evidence, the CI link and the README.md and docs/configuration.md diff lines stating at least 32 characters for both token sources.
